what_happened: 旧 direct-child observer 只接受 EPT_*.exe 名称，因此把真实同源 child 误判为 TARGET_CHILD_NOT_FOUND/DEBUGGER_NOT_REACHED。新的有界自然 observer 不按名称过滤，确认 parent->同源 ept-authoritative.exe child->机器码专业查询工具.exe 两次出现。
observed: run A and B each found an ept-authoritative.exe child in under one second
both runs found C:\Users\flare\Desktop\机器码专业查询工具.exe with SHA-256 7F92E4417CA1464E3EE4CC4DAAC8CD1435573BBC33CF8D0727BB55675AA59AD7
post-clean residue was zero; target seam fields remained NOT_OBSERVED_DYNAMIC
expected_behavior: Observer identifies the target by verified image path/hash and parent/child lineage, not a guessed filename prefix.
impact: The prior name filter hid the real target child and converted an instrument false negative into a misleading runtime diagnosis.
minimal_change: Use an identity-first natural observer with no EPT_*.exe name filter; record image path, SHA-256, parent PID, modules and cleanup.
verification: two independent natural runs with the same verified child lineage
child module list includes python313.dll while parent does not
sample hash unchanged before/after and no residual process
remaining_risk: The observer does not capture target_native_return or target_caller_diff_bytes; a single target-specific instrument is still required.
